title: 1827 Prairie stands at its true height
items: The Doane house was standing about a third taller than its photograph. It is now measured off the photograph through its corrected camera: the cornice is at about 9.4 m, not 12.6 m, and the windows, the mansard, the pavilion's attic and roof, the corner tower and the porch's balcony have all come down with it, as the photograph shows them.
